input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant in § 2(a) runs to Client alone: affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf are not named and there is no mechanism to add them (§ 2(b)(ii) only lets us add sites on notice, not entities), so the clause fails the fallback requirement that affiliates be covered at least on written notice. The transfer limb also falls short: § 15 permits assignment without consent only to a financially responsible affiliate, leaving an M&A successor subject to TrueLink's approval, whereas the fallback requires transferability to a successor. The licence is not revocable at will (§ 2(c) ties it to termination, and termination triggers are breach- or non-renewal-based), so this is not walk-away territory, but the affiliate/contractor exclusion is a material failure. Redline adds affiliates and contractors to the grant and a successor-transfer carve-out to § 15.

proposal.summary: Extend licence to Client's affiliates and contractors and permit transfer to a successor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the licence to our affiliates and to contractors using the Interface on our behalf, since our origination and processing operations are run across affiliated entities and outsourced providers. We also confirmed the licence and this Agreement transfer to a successor in a merger or acquisition so a corporate transaction does not interrupt service.

ops.oldText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface
ops.newText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client, its affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf a non-exclusive license to use the Interface

ops.oldText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate
ops.newText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in interest in connection with a merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of the assigning party's assets
